description: The source presents a transcript of a conversation between Dwarkesh Patel and Richard Sutton, a key figure in reinforcement learning (RL) , often called the "father of RL." Sutton argues that Large Language Models (LLMs) are a "dead end" because they focus on mimicking human actions and language rather than developing a true understanding of the world or internal goals .
